description: Defines classes and functions for E2SM-RC control services, including style definitions, control service base class, and specific style implementations.

classes.name: e2sm_rc_control_service_base
classes.description: Abstract base class for E2SM-RC control services, managing style definitions and control request handling.

classes.name: e2sm_rc_control_service
classes.description: Implementation class for control styles 1-10 of E2SM-RC.

classes.name: e2sm_rc_control_service_style_255
classes.description: Implementation class for control style 255 (Multiple Actions).

methods.name: get_e2sm_rc_control_style_def
methods.description: Retrieves the control service definition for a given style ID.

methods.name: e2sm_rc_control_service_base::get_control_style_definition
methods.description: Returns the control style definition as an ASN.1 structure.

methods.name: e2sm_rc_control_service::control_request_supported
methods.description: Checks if a control request is supported for styles 1-10.

methods.name: e2sm_rc_control_service::execute_control_request
methods.description: Executes a control request for styles 1-10.

methods.name: e2sm_rc_control_service_style_255::control_request_supported
methods.description: Checks if a control request is supported for style 255.

methods.name: e2sm_rc_control_service_style_255::execute_control_request
methods.description: Executes a control request for style 255.
